title: India bonds join global rout after Mideast escalation jolts oil higher
description: Indian government bonds declined early Tuesday amid rising oil prices. Fresh Gulf strikes obstructed shipping, causing Brent crude to climb significantly. This surge in oil prices threatens to increase India's inflation and interest rate risks. Foreign investors sold Indian bonds, marking their first sale since June policy measures. The rupee also dropped, reflecting concerns over the escalating geopolitical situation.

title: Just Dial shares rocket 36% in two days! Why Citi, Kotak, others think Reliance-backed stock can rally up to 62%?
description: Just Dial shares have surged 36% in two sessions after a strong Q1 FY27 earnings report, prompting brokerages to turn bullish. Kotak sees up to 62% upside, while Citi and ICICI Securities maintain positive views, citing revenue growth, healthy cash reserves and improving business fundamentals despite near-term investment risks.

title: Kalyan Jewellers shares skyrocket 50% in 5 days, market value swells by Rs 18,200 crore. Time to buy or book profits?

title: Global Market: Chinese stocks hit three-month lows as growth worries, Middle East tensions weigh
description: Chinese and Hong Kong stocks fell to three-month lows on Tuesday. Investors grew cautious ahead of key economic data and Middle East tensions. China's second-quarter GDP figures are expected to show slower economic expansion. A large initial public offering is also draining market liquidity. Energy shares outperformed as oil prices rose due to geopolitical risks.

title: US Stock Market: Dollar rally gains support as global pension funds unwind FX hedges, easing pressure on greenback
description: Major pension funds are reducing currency hedges, which supports the U.S. dollar's rally. This shift occurs as hedging costs rise due to widening U.S. interest rate differentials. The dollar has also regained its safe-haven status after recent global events. Higher U.S. rates and strong equity returns are underpinning the greenback currently. Future dollar strength will depend on economic growth and AI investment confidence.

title: Caliber Mining & Logistics IPO to open on July 17, price band announced
description: Caliber Mining & Logistics announced its Rs 450-crore IPO price band of Rs 402 to Rs 424. The public issue will open for subscription on July 17 and close on July 21. The company plans to use IPO proceeds for debt repayment and capital expenditure.

title: Biocon shares jump 6% as Mylan likely exits drugmaker after Rs 3,481 crore stake sale
description: Biocon shares experienced a significant jump of over 6% on Tuesday. Viatris-owned Mylan intends to sell a substantial stake, exiting the Indian drugmaker. This stake sale represents 5.64% of Biocon's outstanding shares. The offer's floor price was set at a discount to the previous closing price. Block deals totaling nearly nine crore shares occurred in early trading hours.

title: Global Market:  AI boom turns turbulent as South Korea stocks slide into bear market
description: South Korea's KOSPI has entered bear market territory after falling about 25% from its late-June record high, following a spectacular AI-driven rally. Reuters said the correction highlights risks from the market's heavy reliance on semiconductor stocks and leveraged retail trading.

title: Global Market: South Korea targets AI-led growth, raises 2026 GDP forecast to five-year high; chip stocks in focus
description: South Korea has raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 3%, the fastest pace in five years, backed by an AI and semiconductor-led investment push. The government's plans to boost chip manufacturing, AI infrastructure and exports are expected to support technology stocks despite inflation and bond yield concerns.
